New COVID-19 treatment center providing FREE care for patients in Las Vegas is now open, and coming soon to Washoe County.

For more information ⬇️

TOMORROW: Don't miss out on the @SNHDinfo Veggie Buck Truck to grab a pound of fresh fruits & veggies for just $1! 🍎🍌🥔🥦 Healthy recipe cards, nutrition education, and other resources will also be available.

📍 @RTCSNV, Bonneville Transit Station @ 12:30 PM

My team will be at @NAMISNV's Community Wellness Wednesday fair TODAY from 3 PM to 7 PM to provide information on federal resources and answer questions!

Come by for help from #TeamRosen + health and wellness resources from local organizations.

I joined local leaders in Carson City to talk about the $7 million in investments @SenCortezMasto and I secured for the city, including $2 million to improve the Quill Water Treatment Plant. Access to clean drinking water is critical for the health and success of our state. 🚰 https://t.co/CnTCWlpeq9

A lack of mental health resources available in NV & across the nation hurt our youth. We must ensure children have the resources they need by passing my bill w/ @lisamurkowski to provide K-12 schools with mental health resources to prevent further strain.
https://t.co/NlgrAnw1GI

PTSD can develop at any age for those who have been through an accident, disaster, or another traumatic event. You don't have to suffer alone. 

During #PTSDAwarenessMonth, learn more about the symptoms, causes, and treatment for PTSD. 👇 https://t.co/WAPs8CMaCT

50 years ago, #TitleIX opened the door for women to demand fair treatment in schools and school sports programs.

It also revolutionized women's sports around the country and in Nevada. Read about what it means to some of our local athletes ⬇️
https://t.co/akvdaAvnaU

The opioid crisis continues to impact far too many Nevada families. This $ will help tackle the epidemic by expanding current treatment services, creating new prevention programs, and improving access to transitional housing.
https://t.co/KUUd2nJ68Y

After experiencing mild symptoms, I tested positive for COVID-19 today. I’m thankful to have been fully vaccinated and boosted to protect against severe illness. Following CDC guidelines, I’ll be isolating and continue working remotely on behalf of Nevadans.

This summer as I proudly helped pass the PACT Act – to *finally* ensure veterans exposed to toxic substances get the health treatment & benefits they deserve – I was thinking of Gil.

This new law will finally provide so many vets with the resources they've long deserved. (4/4)

Yesterday, I sat down with the leadership, doctors, nurses, and staff of @IBT631 at their Family Wellness Center in Henderson to learn more about the services they offer, health challenges their patients encounter, and how I'm working in the Senate to help. https://t.co/5oBXOATEW0

The opioid crisis impacts far too many families across NV & our nation. We must remain committed to tackling this epidemic – by expanding treatment & prevention programs, improving access to transitional housing, & stopping deadly fentanyl from entering the U.S. at our border.

The Safe Step Act would ensure patients avoid unnecessary delays in their care and receive the most effective and medically appropriate treatment.

I'm helping introduce this bipartisan bill because all Nevadans deserve access to the best care.

Nevada’s law enforcement officers bravely put their lives on the line to keep our communities safe everyday.

We need to ensure they have the support they need - including access to mental health services. I'll continue working to make sure they do.
https://t.co/KLSCLjfIkr

Glad to meet with @NVSOS @CiscoAguilar, Deputy SOS for SNV @MaggieSC_, & Nevada election workers this week.

At a time when democracy continues to face attack, their dedication to ensuring every Nevadan is able to exercise their voice at the ballot box couldn't be more important. https://t.co/jvDnphnZYm

As co-founder of the Comprehensive Care Caucus, I’m introducing bipartisan legislation to make palliative and hospice care more accessible and available.

I’ll continue fighting to ensure more families can access the care and treatment they need.

The rights of LGBTQ+ Americans are under attack and we must fight to protect them.

I'm supporting legislation to ensure LGBTQ+ couples receive equal treatment by the @IRSnews to access the same tax refunds as other couples.
I also sat down with IAFF Local 731 to discuss my work to support our first responders' mental health and wellness. https://t.co/HmGzy4vqie

Great news: more than $7.2 million I helped secure for law enforcement across Nevada has been delivered! 

This funding will support police, law enforcement, and first responders across Nevada with critical equipment upgrades, needed officer wellness programs, and much more.

Unions help hardworking families reach the American Dream.

As @UAW workers exercise their right to fight for better wages and benefits, we stand in solidarity.
.@Culinary226 workers power Nevada’s economy. I stand with them as they exercise their right to bargain for better wages and a fair contract – because one job should be enough.

We live in a union state, and I stand in solidarity with @uaw2162 members as they exercise their right to bargain for better wages.

I joined the picket line in Reno to send a clear message: when unions succeed, families benefit. https://t.co/4oiFLqLM6g

Nevada’s law enforcement officers risk so much to protect our communities. 

Proud to see that more funding is coming to our state to invest in police officers’ mental health and wellness and provide them with the resources they need to keep us safe.

In order to best serve and protect our state, Nevada's law enforcement officers need the resources to take care of themselves.

Earlier this week, @SenCortezMasto and I announced investments for officers’ mental health and wellness so they can best serve our communities. ⬇️ https://t.co/FRfYfwHJc4

A mother with a life-threatening pregnancy has been denied the life-saving treatment she needs because of Texas’ extreme abortion ban.

It’s the first time in 50 years a court has ruled whether a woman can get an abortion.

We need to protect reproductive freedoms in federal law. https://t.co/GEMdoOE05x
